primary_endpoint: Net pretax compounded return difference in percentage points, selected strategy minus QQQ buy-and-hold

source_quality.reference_scope: Session dates only; not price validation

prior_research_disclosure: The historical period was previously explored. Test observations are excluded from this parameter-selection procedure, but are not an untouched research holdout.
interpretation: Retrospective held-out diagnostic, not live or previously untouched evidence

limitations.primary: Alpha Vantage QQQ daily raw closes, distributions and split coefficients
limitations.completeness_check: Independent Yahoo daily session dates; no strategy performance used
limitations.prior_inputs_excluded: Old signals, optimized parameters, synthetic price caches and performance reports
limitations.price_vintage: Retrospective vendor cache, not point-in-time quotes
limitations.accounting_clock: 16:00 America/New_York on each source session date
limitations.clock_limitation: Daily accounting convention, not verified early-close or live signal availability
